header: Stages chained with arrows, input to output
lead: Use it where the boxes are system states rather than things the reader does. Where the reader is the one performing them, the how-it-works band is the right one.
note: The note takes the legend or the caveat the diagram itself has no room for.

stages.title: Column first
stages.text: On a phone the chain runs downwards, arrows and all.

stages.title: Row above 768px
stages.text: The arrows turn and sit exactly in the gap between two stages.

stages.title: Two to six stages
stages.text: Beyond six the row is too narrow to read and the diagram stops helping.

stages.title: A closing note
stages.text: For the caveat the boxes have no room for.
